**English version**

**Bekubes Open Aranjuez 2025**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition.
The competition is open to all competitors of all nationalities. Registration is available on the WCA website. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA Regulations
The competition is free to spectators and guests.

items.name: Utah Championship 2025
items.information:
This is the State Championship for Utah. To be recognized as the Utah Champion, please register your state of residence on [CubingUSA!](https://cubingusa.org/) Anyone may register for the competition but only Utah Residents are eligible for the Utah Champion title.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the [Registration and Waistlist Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahChampionship2023#30564-registration-and-waitlist-info) tab. 

Go to our [website](utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBblkvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--78136ba2316603f64144b1e4187349c9f12b5dd9/image.png)](https://utahcubing.org)

items.name: Back to Buchy 2025
items.information:
L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#54927-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). 

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#54927-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

items.name: Mahalo iā Maui 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### Come join us for our annual WCA competition on the beautiful island of Maui!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.
